checks_before_evaluation: per coin: the notebook-17 phase-1 manifest exists and the 2020-11..2022-12 archive SHA-256 equal it; 2021 event count and training positives, M0 refit coefficients, and 2022 thresholds and calibration alert counts of M0, M1 and GBM reproduce notebook 17 phase 1; during evaluation: F = 1 at H = 240 and standard AUC - 1/2 = (1 - pi)(pre-onset AUC - 1/2) + pi (in-progress AUC - 1/2) for every coin, definition and score

evaluation.F: share of evaluation events whose onset-to-breach gap is at most 239 minutes (some pre-onset minute in the judging window)
evaluation.bootstrap: 1000 draws of 7-day calendar blocks common to all coins (174 blocks), 95% percentile intervals over finite draws
evaluation.coverage_caution: reported, not used in the readings: common-minute share of evaluation minutes below 80% or a missing month in the evaluation period
evaluation.data_gaps: minutes with a missing-price run (more than 5 minutes) within the next 245 minutes are excluded (label not determinable); counted
evaluation.definitions: price-only catalog with the coin d4 decline, look-back H in {240, 1440} minutes; judging window 30-240 minutes; in progress = at or after the 1% onset
evaluation.labels: positives from the coin full catalog on evaluation minutes (Bitcoin convention); events breaching within 240 minutes after the start are not in the event list or F but their in-window minutes stay positive; their number is reported
evaluation.minutes: valid minutes with all four scores finite and an RV decile
evaluation.per_coin_window: [max(2023-01-01, first UTC day with finite z_vol and z_hs + 1 day), min(2026-05-01, end of the last published month)); minutes within 245 minutes of the end dropped; coin excluded if fewer than 180 days
evaluation.pooling: equal-weight mean over coins (pre-onset quantities over coins with pre-onset positives); pooled S_in = mean(pi (AUC_in - 1/2)) / mean(AUC - 1/2)
evaluation.quantities: standard, pre-onset, in-progress and within-regime pre-onset AUC; pi; S_in; GBM - M0 differences
evaluation.regime: deciles of the coin's own RV over its evaluation minutes

models.B0: 24-hour realized volatility of one-minute log returns (1440 minutes, at least 720)
models.source: notebook-17 COIN_MODELS_FROZEN.json (sha256 15ad92add6970be94344562b8d2929a0375e637b50a1e6cd64f74ff471f44eee), definition d4, read only

prior_use: XRP, LTC, BNB, ADA, EOS, TRX, ETC, XLM, NEO 2023-2026 data not downloaded before in this study; ETH 2020-01..2026-04 read in notebook 10 (shared alert budget, alert counts only); Bitcoin results for this period known; models fitted on 2021 and calibrated on 2022 (notebook 17), so 2023-2026 is outside their fitting data; not a registered holdout

readings.A1: H=240: M0 pooled S_in lower bound >= 0.25 -> in-progress share large; upper bound < 0.25 -> not large; otherwise inconclusive
readings.A2: F at H=1440 per coin and pooled (sum of events): descriptive; F at H=240 must equal 1 by Corollary 1 (implementation check; stops otherwise)
readings.A3: H=1440: pooled GBM - M0 standard-AUC interval above zero AND pooled pre-onset interval below zero -> replicated; standard interval below zero OR pre-onset interval above zero -> contradicted; otherwise inconclusive; per-coin direction counts reported
readings.A4: H=240 pooled GBM - M0 differences (standard, pre-onset, in-progress, within-regime pre-onset): descriptive
readings.finite_draws: A1 and A3 are inconclusive when an interval end is not finite or fewer than 95% of draws are finite

status: exploratory; frozen coin models; development period; no confirmatory plan changed; notebook-17 folder read only
title: Ten altcoins over the development period 2023-01-01 to 2026-05-01: per-minute decomposition and the 24-hour ranking reversal with the notebook-17 frozen coin models (exploratory)
